criteria.narrative:
Awarded after instructor review confirmed at least 75% on each required activity: M5A5 (HAUDEX app).

Award threshold: 75%.

m5a5: HAUDEX app. Built a Flutter app with a monster list, an add form, navigation to a detail screen and an attack action that updates HP. The assessment covered input validation, state, phone layout, consistent design and code organization.
